text: Fidelity and delivery: steady-state agreement with the HMB cases of 2 % or better on the main process variables and correct dynamic behaviour (trends and time constants) within 5 %; a minimum of 200 malfunctions; delivered 6 months before first fire (ER-12.06) and updated to the final logic before the start of the commissioning; the simulator is used to test the start-up sequences, the trip logic and the operator procedures before the site tests.
